mapper.select: INSERT INTO TripInfo SET regDate = NOW(), updateDate = NOW(), tripName = '대전여행', tripRegion = #{tripRegion}, tripStartDate = #{tripStartDate}, tripEndDate = #{tripEndDate}, memberId = #{memberId};
INSERT INTO tripDay SET tripId = #{tripId}, dayIndex = #{dayIndex}, `date` = #{date}, startTime = #{startTime}, endTime = #{endTime}

SELECT TL.*, TLP.pictureUrl AS extra__pictureUrl, TLT.typeName AS extra__locationType FROM tripLocation AS TL LEFT JOIN tripLocationPicture AS TLP ON TL.id = TLP.tripLocationId INNER JOIN tripLocationType AS TLT ON TL.locationTypeId = TLT.id WHERE TL.id = #{tripLocationId} GROUP BY TL.id
